title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user who can edit and run a playbook on a permitted label could cause Splunk…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with permissions to edit and run a playbook on a permitted label can cause the system to return custom-function status and callback state from a different playbook run. This occurs due to insufficient binding between the custom-function-status request and the initiating playbook run.
